headword: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}
gloss: transfer guide; route guide; transit-routing app

definitions.gloss: transfer guide; transit-routing service; train route finder
definitions.explanation: Information showing how to transfer between trains, subways, or buses to get from one station to another. Also the generic name for smartphone apps and web services (notably 'Yahoo!{乗換案内|のりかえあんない}') that calculate such routes.

examples.japanese: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{乗換案内|のりかえあんない}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: The transit-routing app is very handy.

examples.japanese: {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{調|しら}べたら→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧、⟦{次|つぎ}の{駅|えき}→次の駅：23576_tsuginoeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}える→乗り換える：01194_norikaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧わかった。
examples.english: When I checked the route finder, I learned that transferring to the express at the next station is fastest.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換え：16130_norikae⟧ (transfer between trains/lines) + ⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧ (guide, information). Originally referred to printed timetables and station signs, but in everyday speech today it most often refers to a smartphone app or website.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up a transfer route
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: transit-routing app
- {乗換案内|のりかえあんない}{所|じょ}: information desk for transfers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{換|か}え→乗り換え：16130_norikae⟧: transfer (the act of changing trains/lines)
- ⟦{時刻表|じこくひょう}→時刻表：01031_jikokuhyou⟧: timetable
- ⟦{経路|けいろ}→経路：13796_keiro⟧⟦{検索|けんさく}→検索：04729_kensaku⟧: route search (more technical term for the same feature)
